records.subject: spec-guard-0.60.2-codex-copy
evidence: result:both run green from the installed copy (10 and 21 cases)
command:codex exec -s workspace-write "<write the Spec and hand it over>" / "<keep building to the next checkpoint>"

result:two temporary projects were set up with the installed copy: one whose only module still needs a Spec, one whose only (and therefore last) module has an approved Plan with one task and a final gate; the prompts did not mention documents
result:Spec handoff: the handoff carried a documentation-suggestion item (a short README with prerequisites and usage, to be adopted or not at review)

result:last module's final gate: the session stopped at the gate (commit blocked by the missing author, reported) and ended with a README stance ("no new README needed, usage is in the Spec") -- the close-out point was followed only for the README, not as a full close-out suggestion

result:the capability-map review point was not exercised; not verified. The trust entries codex exec added to ~/.codex/config.toml for the temporary directories were the only differences and were removed afterwards
